bds.lede: Kilmar Ábrego García, a Salvadoran national who fought his mistaken deportation, arrived in Spain on Wednesday after voluntarily leaving the United States, potentially ending a defining saga of the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.
rows: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the Salvadoran national who was mistakenly deported by ICE last year, arrived in Spain after voluntarily leaving the U.S., CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez reports.

Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the Salvadoran national who fought his mistaken deportation from the U.S., arrived in Spain on Wednesday after voluntarily leaving the United States, potentially ending a defining saga of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.
His deportation to and return from El Salvador became a flashpoint in the debate the US president's immigration agenda.
